title: Zeptly Registry Protocol v0.1: shared definitions (QB registry rendering)
$comment: Implements the common envelope vocabulary of the approved Zeptly Registry Protocol v0.1. The exact identifier grammar and digest canonicalisation are QB-registry choices where the protocol is silent.

semverRange.description: npm-style semver range (^1.2.0, ~1.2, >=1.0.0 <2.0.0) or an exact version. Verified semantically by the validator.

registryName.description: The four class registries covered by the protocol. Platform contracts (capabilities, gateways, models) are NOT registries and are never referenced this way.

artifactId.description: Registry-local artifact identifier: dot-separated lowercase slugs (e.g. research.web-fact-check, source-evaluation). Repository-independent.

ref.description: Structured cross-registry reference {registry, id, version, digest?}. `version` may be a range in declarations; runtime resolution records an exact version and digest.

exactRef.description: Exact-version reference (provenance, resolution locks, lineage). Digest recommended.

platformId.description: OPAQUE platform-contract token (capability or gateway). Namespace ownership and gateway contracts are separate platform contracts and are unresolved; this registry does not interpret these tokens beyond shape.

evidenceUri.description: Opaque pointer into an evidence store: evidence://<store>/<path>. Never a URL or filesystem path. Raw tapes/trajectories are never stored in Git.

maturity.description: Independent of origin and lifecycle. `candidate` is a registry object under evaluation; `canonical` is sealed, immutable and digest-addressed.

lifecycle.description: Append-only overlay state, independent of maturity and origin.
